verdict.rationale: Termius delivers secure SSH-based access to servers through jump hosts, local/remote/dynamic port forwarding, and direct connections without a cloud proxy or VPN. Authentication is hardened with FIDO2 keys, MFA, and device-bound biometric keys. Nothing in the evidence shows native Kubernetes cluster access, which is an explicit part of the story; reaching clusters would rely on SSH tunnels or port forwarding as a workaround. Missing for 10: native Kubernetes cluster access/integration, support for non-SSH resource types (databases, cloud-native endpoints), independent corroboration of the access model.
